summary: Comprehensive testing of Custom Test Builder feature and NexUacademy branding. All 4 steps of test builder wizard (Exam Type, Topic Selection, Configuration, Preview) working correctly. Test Taking Interface with timer, question navigation, flagging, and submission fully functional. Results display shows score, percentage, accuracy, and question-wise analysis.

issues: ESLint warnings: useEffect missing dependencies - minor code quality issue

seed_data_creation: Database already has 13,415 questions. Tests generate new test entries in 'tests' collection and attempts in 'test_attempts' collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom Test Builder wizard fully functional: Step 1 (Exam Type: JEE Main/Advanced/Mixed), Step 2 (Topic Selection with chapter expansion and question counts per topic), Step 3 (Configure duration, year range, question counts), Step 4 (Preview with subject-wise breakdown, Save Template, Generate & Start Test). TakeTestPage shows timer, question display, MCQ options, Question Palette, navigation, flagging, Clear button, Submit. Results show score, correct/incorrect/skipped counts, percentage, accuracy, time taken, and question-wise analysis with user answer vs correct answer.
